The biggest shock to my system came from something so small: drinks. I used to grab a can of soda or a latte every time I needed a pick-me-up. But as I started drinking more water throughout the day, I quickly realized how much of my weight was actually excess sugar. Not only did my cravings decrease, but my skin cleared up and my energy levels improved within a week.
